mainEntity.name: Can I search by Uma Musume Trainer ID?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Use the Trainer ID filter to find the matching submitted records in the Global database.

mainEntity.name: Can I search for specific sparks or factors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Filter blue stat factors, red aptitude factors, green unique skills, and white skill, race, or scenario sparks, including required star levels.

mainEntity.name: How do I compare parent affinity?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sort or filter database results by affinity, then open a record in the lineage planner to calculate the full family tree and shared race bonuses.

schema.name: Uma Musume Affinity Calculator & Lineage Planner

mainEntity.name: What is affinity in Uma Musume?

acceptedAnswer.text: Affinity, also called compatibility, is the relationship score between a trainee and her inheritance characters. Higher affinity improves the chance that inherited factors activate.

mainEntity.name: How is Uma Musume compatibility calculated?

acceptedAnswer.text: Select the trainee and her lineage. The calculator combines character compatibility with applicable shared-race bonuses throughout the family tree.
Choose compatible inheritance characters and plan overlapping race wins across the family tree. The Optimal Races action identifies useful shared G1 wins for the selected lineage.
